legal_clauses.assignability_clause: This Assignment is assignable by the Assignee to any third party, with or without the consent of the Assignor.
legal_clauses.indemnification: The Assignor shall indemnify and hold harmless the Assignee from and against any and all claims, damages, and expenses arising from any breach of this Assignment.
legal_clauses.governing_law: This Assignment shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
legal_clauses.dispute_resolution: Any disputes arising from this Assignment shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association.
legal_clauses.closing_obligations: The Assignee shall be responsible for ensuring that all closing obligations are met, including but not limited to, the payment of all closing costs and the delivery of the deed.
